10k.note: Lead candidate is sublingual high-dose aspirin pursued via 505(b)(2) NDA pathway; small Florida PK study completed July 2025.

website.note: Website describes sublingual delivery technology platform; no specific drug names beyond aspirin shown; no NCT IDs disclosed.

ctgov.note: No trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov under sponsor name Aspire Biopharma.

pipeline.license_origin: Aspire proprietary delivery platform (patent pending; provisional 63/702,381 filed Oct 2024)

indications.highest_phase: Phase 1 (PK study completed July 2025; pivotal trial planned 2026 ahead of 505(b)(2) NDA submission late 2026)
indications.trial_name: Florida PK study (single-dose pharmacokinetics in healthy adult volunteers)
indications.trial_design: Open-label crossover PK study comparing sublingual high-dose aspirin product vs standard oral aspirin in 6 healthy adult volunteers; 14-day washout between doses; final report received Sept 5, 2025.
indications.trial_status: Phase 1 PK study COMPLETED July 2025; next clinical trials being prepared (CDMO Microsize engaged Jan 2026 to manufacture supplies for next round); 505(b)(2) NDA submission targeted late 2026.
key_milestones: Florida PK trial completed July 2025; report Sept 2025
CDMO Microsize engaged Jan 2026 for next-round clinical supply

excluded_preclinical: Other sublingual reformulations referenced in passing (pain, ED, TBI, opioid alternatives) - all preclinical/conceptual, not yet IND-stage.
